name: Hansel and Gretel
description: A playable adaptation of Hansel and Gretel with Village, Court, Forest, and Cursed factions.

legal.license: Based on Hansel and Gretel by the Brothers Grimm (public domain).
legal.disclaimer: Declarative BloodScribe content pack. It does not execute remote code.

popularity.note: Snapshot of the public role vote ordering, from most liked to least liked. The endpoint exposes ordering, not aggregate vote counts.

books.name: Hansel and Gretel
books.description: A playable adaptation of Hansel and Gretel with Village, Court, Forest, and Cursed factions.

collection.name: Brothers Grimm
collection.description: Collection of tales and characters inspired by the Brothers Grimm.

info.name: Hansel
info.ability: Each night, choose another player. If an abandonment, poison, or death ability targets them, learn the faction of one source.

cues.body: Hansel chooses another player and marks them with a White Pebble.
Hansel chooses another player and receives any pending source-faction information at dawn.

info.name: Gretel
info.ability: Once per game, publicly accuse a player of being the Oven Witch. If correct, they die; if wrong, you die.

presentation.label: Gretel accuses
presentation.title: Gretel
presentation.description: Publicly choose the player you believe has the Oven Witch trait and record the outcome.

info.name: The Woodcutter
info.ability: Each night, protect a player from abandonment and feeding. On the first day, you cannot speak or vote.

cues.body: The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.
The Woodcutter chooses a player to protect.

effects.instruction: Resuelve manualmente esta protección cuando se intente abandonar o cebar al objetivo.
effects.reason: Abandono y cebado no son todavía eventos tipados.

info.name: The Starving Mother
info.ability: Each night, abandon a player other than last night's target. They lose their ability, speech, and vote through the following day.

cues.body: The Starving Mother chooses a player to abandon.
She chooses a player other than last night's target.

info.name: The Oven Witch
info.ability: Each night, feed two players. A protected target gains no new mark. A player dies when receiving their third Feeding mark.

cues.body: The Oven Witch chooses two players to feed.
Choose two players, advance their Feeding marks, and resolve any threshold deaths.

info.name: The White Bird
info.ability: Each night, learn a player's faction. You win personally if you survive after guiding at least one {{team:grimm:pueblo}} and one {{team:grimm:bosque}}.

cues.body: The White Bird chooses a player and learns their faction.
The White Bird chooses a player and learns their faction.

effects.instruction: Comprueba manualmente que el Pájaro Blanco siga vivo y haya observado personajes de ambos equipos requeridos.
effects.reason: La atribución histórica de observaciones aún requiere decisión del Narrador.

info.name: The River Duck
info.ability: Once per game, prevent a voted execution. The saved player is exiled and cannot speak or vote until the next dawn.

presentation.label: The Duck rescues
presentation.title: The River Duck
presentation.description: When a voted execution is about to resolve, choose its candidate and prevent their death.

info.name: The Rooftop Cat
info.ability: Once per game at night, choose two players. Targeted abilities aimed at either affect the other. You win personally if you survive.

cues.body: The Cat may choose two players to swap.
If unused, the Cat may choose two players to swap.

effects.reason: El Gato del Tejado sobrevive al final de la partida.

info.name: The Forest Hunter
info.ability: Each night, mark a player. If they are nominated the next day, you may kill them immediately. Win personally after killing a {{team:grimm:bosque}} and a {{team:grimm:corte}}.

cues.body: The Hunter marks a player as quarry.
The Hunter marks a player as quarry.

presentation.description: {characterName}: {playerName} was nominated and may die immediately.

effects.reason: El Cazador del Bosque mató al menos un personaje de cada equipo requerido.

info.name: The Crossroads Crone
info.ability: Each night, protect a player from abandonment. You cannot choose the same player two nights in a row.

cues.body: The Crone gives one player a Provision.
She gives a Provision to someone other than last night's target.

effects.instruction: Resuelve manualmente esta protección cuando se intente abandonar o cebar al objetivo.
effects.reason: Abandono y cebado no son todavía eventos tipados.

info.name: The Fire Spirit
info.ability: Each night, mark a player with fire; their second mark kills them. If a character with the Oven Witch trait dies, you die.

cues.body: The Fire Spirit marks a player with Fire.
Advance one player's Fire mark and resolve any threshold death.

info.name: The Bird Shepherd
info.ability: Each night, choose two players and learn whether they belong to the same faction.

cues.body: The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.
The Shepherd chooses two players and learns Same or Different.

presentation.title: Do they belong to the same faction?

info.name: The Midwife
info.ability: Once per game, declare a player innocent. If they are {{team:grimm:pueblo}}, protect them from execution and abandonment; otherwise, you die.

presentation.label: The Midwife declares
presentation.title: The Midwife
presentation.description: Publicly choose a player and record whether they belong to the Village.

effects.instruction: Aplica manualmente la protección frente al abandono.
effects.reason: El abandono no es aún un evento tipado.

narrativeSetting.location: Central European village beside a deep forest
narrativeSetting.atmosphere: Hunger, cold, and the smell of burnt sugar
narrativeSetting.nuances: Children's tale nightmare, rural folklore, and an oven that is always lit

text.name: Hansel and Gretel
text.tagline: Pebbles, hunger, and a burning oven: find the way home before the forest devours you.
text.description: A playable adaptation of Hansel and Gretel with Village, Court, Forest, and Cursed factions.

nightInstructions.opening: Make sure every player has closed their eyes. Resolve target swaps before other targeted abilities.
nightInstructions.dawn: Wake the village, announce deaths, and deliver any tracked-target information.

gameEndRules.reason: Todos los personajes oscuros han sido eliminados y queda al menos un personaje bueno vivo.
No queda ningún personaje bueno vivo.
